facts.fact: KIX-SEEDS says its KIX-ALERTE machine-learning module for early prediction of school dropout and a KIX-CHATBOT IA for querying education data are tools of its pilot in the communes of Manga and Bingo, with generalisation of the alert system to all communes still to come.

KIX-SEEDS, led by ISSP / Universite Joseph KI-ZERBO, says it designed the KIX-ALERTE dropout-prediction machine-learning module and the KIX-CHATBOT IA on its seeds.bf platform, used in the pilot communes of Manga and Bingo.

KIX-SEEDS says its pilot in the communes of Manga and Bingo follows over 12,000 pupils individually by unique identifier on a digital platform with modules for teachers' grades, school management and public statistics, with integration into the national SIGE still to come.
KIX-SEEDS says its KIX-DHIS2 module is an interoperability interface with the national DHIS2 system in its pilot platform.

KIX-SEEDS says teachers in its pilot enter pupils' marks in an offline-capable Android app and report cards are produced the day of entry, while school heads follow attendance and performance in real time.
KIX-SEEDS says the system runs in the pilot communes of Manga and Bingo, with extension to several regions still planned.
